boomzoo.description: A Bomberman-style game with zoo animals: drop bombs in a maze of blocks to clear the way and blast your rivals. One or two players.

formduel.description: A Puyo Puyo-style falling-piece duel. The story mode pits you against twelve caricatures of Taiwanese public figures, with voices in Taiwanese Hokkien; there is also a two-player duel.

gamblord.description: Taiwanese 16-tile mahjong against three opponents drawn as cartoon versions of well-known people, in free play or a series of matches.

jttlaugh.description: A humorous platform game loosely based on Journey to the West: Sun Wukong, the Monkey King, jumps and fights his way through the stages. Often named the best game on the console.

magipool.description: Pool with digitized photos of the players: a story mode across a world map, plus challenge, versus and practice modes, for one or two players.

monopoly.description: A Monopoly-style board game set in Africa: build farms, quarries and hotels where you land, and spend the income on supplies for the hunt for a treasure hidden in the middle of the board. Up to six players.

rebelst.description: Turn-based science-fiction strategy: the rebel 21st squad of battle mechs fights the Titan empire across the map. Finished but never sold: only a few sample cartridges exist.

sangofgt.description: One-on-one fighting with the generals of the Three Kingdoms, in arcade and versus modes for one or two players. A port of Panda Entertainment's 1993 PC game.

speedyd.description: A fast side-scrolling platform game in the style of Sonic: a boy with a baseball bat dashes through six stages against the clock, collecting baseballs and facing a boss at the end of each, with a 3D bonus stage.

slghtsag.description: A tactical role-playing game in the style of Shining Force, converted from a Taiwanese PC game; the console version adds towns explored from above.

staiwbbl.description: Baseball with the licensed teams and players of Taiwan's professional league (CPBL), big animations on key plays and digitized crowd sound. Season, exhibition and all-star modes for one or two players; the season is saved on the cartridge.

sonevil.description: A role-playing game seen from above, meant as the console's flagship. Dialogue choices, even with minor characters, and key decisions shape the story and can make the hero good or evil.
